name: Jüchen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Jüchen (a crescent, a star, a church and a lion on blue).
history: The crescent and star of the arms may have come to the Rhineland from the Orient through the crusades.

features.role: Jüchen arms — crescent, star, church and lion on blue
